contract.userJob: Explore several choices, understand why they fit, and narrow the set confidently.

layout.wide: Feature one grounded match while keeping the collection and filters easy to scan.
layout.compact: Stack the featured choice, filters, and collection with progressive detail.

contract.fallback: Preserve all recommendations, fit reasons, constraints, uncertainty, and sources.

gaps: Featured choice, collection, filters, comparison, and details lack a scalable browsing model.
Trusted media behavior beyond person profiles needs scenario-level evidence.
quality.nextAction: Define a three-to-many recommendation browsing contract with honest media and comparison behavior.
